comparison_cutoff: Completed local V3.6 interface followup before Sep 6 continuation; not the older public commit.
counter_scope: V3.6 development ledger only. Includes initial candidate-score rows and replay executions; excludes historical V3.5 representation records. Not independent sample size.

measurement_v22.scope: Same 768 outputs under different author-developed rubrics; coverage change is not accuracy improvement or independent validity.

uncertainty: Rate difference bounds are logical ranges over unresolved author judgments, not confidence intervals, and do not include sampling error or all author-grading error.

evidence_scope.scope_note: This does not erase the earlier project human audits or frozen review gates; those do not automatically transfer to these new diagnostic materials.
